shots.title: Opening Establishing Shot
shots.narrativeIntent: Establish the visual world at the beginning of the track.
shots.prompt: Replace with a self-contained continuous cinematic shot description including subject, action, environment, camera, light, atmosphere and motion.
shots.negativePrompt: visible text, logos, unsafe likeness, malformed anatomy, abrupt internal cut, camera shake

shots.title: Primary Release Shot
shots.narrativeIntent: Provide the strongest visual release for the high-energy section.
shots.prompt: Replace with a different self-contained continuous cinematic shot that resolves or transforms the opening world while preserving continuity.
shots.negativePrompt: visible text, logos, unsafe likeness, malformed anatomy, abrupt internal cut, camera shake
